scientific_integrity: The coordinate closure is proved by explicit minimal and maximal elements of a box intersected with a total-order cone. Possible and certified feasibility are derived from those exact coordinate extrema, and the constrained-argmin formula follows from Cartesian factorization across methods. The strict example is checked with exact rational arithmetic. The time-uniform claim uses exactly the original simultaneous confidence event plus deterministic nesting; it adds no probabilistic assumption or error allocation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires pathwise nested prediction sets, common predictable exposure weights across the ordered levels, nonincreasing tolerances, and method-specific order-restricted boxes that are nonempty. It does not apply to crossing pipelines, differing exposure sequences, or general partial orders without modification.
title: Exact isotonic sharpening of coverage-constrained sequential model confidence sets
